title: Lucas Museum of Narrative Art Opens to Public in Los Angeles
seoTitle: Lucas Museum of Narrative Art Opens in Los Angeles
subtitle: Futuristic Installation Offers Free Entry for Local Residents
excerpt: The Lucas Museum of Narrative Art has opened its doors in Los Angeles, drawing Star Wars fans and art lovers alike.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The Lucas Museum of Narrative Art opened to the public in Los Angeles this Thursday, attracting visitors interested in both Star Wars and other forms of visual storytelling. The inauguration includes free admission for residents of local zip codes and a public garden.

Opening and Free Access

The museum began welcoming visitors on September 22, with free admission for area residents. This policy aims to integrate the community with the city's new cultural landmark.

Building Architecture and Design

The structure features a curved white facade resembling a spaceship, with a green roof that rises above the highway. The central lobby boasts glass elevators reminiscent of science fiction settings, in addition to a spacious theater for film screenings.

Star Wars Exhibition

One of the main attractions is the collection of Star Wars artifacts, which includes costumes, droids, and vehicles arranged in settings that recreate moments from the films. Among the highlights are Darth Vader's original suit, C-3PO and R2-D2 droids, and an X-wing suspended in the lobby.

Narrative Art Collections

Beyond the film franchise, the museum features works that explore narrative throughout history, such as the Aztec Sun Stone, projections of the Sistine Chapel, Mickey Mouse drawings, and anime and manga illustrations. There is also a space dedicated to Norman Rockwell and an original Banksy piece.

Public Spaces and Garden

The grounds around the building have been transformed into a free park, featuring bronze sculptures, including a statue of Princess Leia. The observation deck offers panoramic views of the city and the garden, reinforcing the commitment to community accessibility.

With information from Space.
